summary: Iteration 4 backend + frontend testing: ALL 16 acceptance criteria PASS. Backend Settings API (GET public, PUT admin-only with 401 on unauth, persistence) verified via 5 pytest cases (5/5 pass). Frontend verified end-to-end across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): Hero Bengali matras fully visible (reveal-mask padding-top=12.096px), mobile navbar shows 'Banani Clinic / SPECIALIZED HOSPITAL' text, footer admin link removed, footer has Apixel link to https://www.apixel.net target=_blank, MarqueeBar present on /, /gallery, /about, /privacy, /terms with marquee-track animation, navbar offset (top-9) applied when marquee active, hero 2-col layout with right image card + AACD সনদপ্রাপ্ত badge + Dr. Aslam Almehdi name card, doctors section centered, About page shows /brand/owner.jpg (1600x1448) with AACD MEMBER badge. Admin /admin/settings reachable via sidebar (data-testid='admin-nav-সেটিংস'), marquee-toggle/marquee-text/settings-save all functional, save shows success toast 'পরিবর্তন সংরক্ষিত হয়েছে', disabling marquee + reload public page → marquee-bar NOT rendered and navbar top-0. Cleanup performed: marqueeEnabled restored to true with original Bengali text via API verification.
verified_passing_items: PUT /api/settings with admin Bearer token updates marqueeEnabled+marqueeText, persists across GET
Hero .reveal-mask computed paddingTop=12.096px, marginTop=-12.096px (Bengali top matras NOT cut off)
Mobile (390x844) nav-logo innerText = 'Banani Clinic\nSPECIALIZED HOSPITAL', width=151px (fully visible)
Footer has NO data-testid='footer-admin-link' AND zero anchors with /admin in href
Footer data-testid='footer-apixel' href=https://www.apixel.net target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer
MarqueeBar has .marquee-track child + class 'fixed top-0 z-[60]' (CSS marquee animation)
Navbar has class 'top-9' when marqueeEnabled=true (correct offset to sit below marquee)
Hero right image card: img alt='Confident smile - Banani Clinic' + AACD সনদপ্রাপ্ত badge + Dr. Aslam Almehdi name card
Doctors section header centered via 'text-center' ancestor; cards mx-auto with dynamic max-w by count
About page owner image: src=/brand/owner.jpg, naturalWidth=1600, naturalHeight=1448, alt='Assoc. Prof. Dr. Aslam Almehdi'
About page has 'Dr. Aslam Almehdi' text and 'AACD MEMBER' badge
Admin login (admin/Admin@2026) succeeds; sidebar data-testid='admin-nav-সেটিংস' navigates to /admin/settings
/admin/settings has marquee-toggle, marquee-text, settings-save data-testids; save shows success toast
After admin disables marquee + reloads /, marquee-bar NOT rendered and navbar class contains 'top-0'
Final cleanup: API GET /api/settings returns marqueeEnabled=true with original Bengali default text
critical_code_review_comments: MarqueeBar.jsx reads /api/settings on every public-page mount; same data is also fetched independently by Navbar.jsx (duplicate request). Could be lifted into a shared context/hook to halve marquee API calls on initial load.
Settings model uses singleton pattern with key:'site' unique - reasonable; idempotent getOrCreate is safe for cold-start.
PUT validation only checks typeof; no length cap on marqueeText. Consider 280-char limit to prevent abuse via admin panel.
Hero.jsx uses Pexels external URL for hero image — works but adds external dependency; consider self-hosting to /brand/ for resilience.
owner.jpg is 2.5MB at 1600x1448 — large for web; consider serving a 800x720 WebP variant for /about above-the-fold.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded data; transient TEST_marquee text was overwritten back to original Bengali default per request
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 complete with no issues. Backend Settings model + routes work correctly. Marquee toggle persisted state verified. Admin UI testids: admin-nav-সেটিংস, marquee-toggle, marquee-text, settings-save. Public site marquee restored to enabled=true. Login form inputs use data-testid='login-username' and 'login-password' (no name attribute). Public testids: marquee-bar, site-navbar (with top-7 md:top-9 class when marquee active), nav-logo, footer-apixel. About owner image at /brand/owner.jpg.
